import math

f = 256.0
H = 1.55
cx = 255.5
cy = 255.5

# obs_0084 pose:
# from frame 80 (x=-0.1355, y=3.2658, heading=135)
# 81: turn 45 -> heading=180, move 0 -> pose (-0.1355, 3.2658)
# 82: turn 0, move 0.75 along 180 (sin 180 = 0, cos 180 = -1) -> pose (-0.1355, 2.5158)
# 83: turn 0, move 0.75 along 180 -> pose (-0.1355, 1.7658)
# 84: turn 45 -> heading=225, move 0 -> pose (-0.1355, 1.7658)

x_cam, y_cam, heading = -0.1355, 1.7658, 225.0
rad = math.radians(heading)
# base row = 480, col = 472 (center of [447, 496])
u = (447 + 496) / 2
v = 480
D = f * H / (v - cy)
x_c = D * (u - cx) / f
y_c = D
x_w = x_cam + y_c * math.sin(rad) + x_c * math.cos(rad)
y_w = y_cam + y_c * math.cos(rad) - x_c * math.sin(rad)

print(f'Jug base: x={x_w:.4f}, y={y_w:.4f}, D={D:.4f}')

# Corner at row 346, col 313
v_corner = 346
u_corner = 313
D_corner = f * H / (v_corner - cy)
xc_c = D_corner * (u_corner - cx) / f
yc_c = D_corner
xw_c = x_cam + yc_c * math.sin(rad) + xc_c * math.cos(rad)
yw_c = y_cam + yc_c * math.cos(rad) - xc_c * math.sin(rad)
print(f'SW Room Corner: x={xw_c:.4f}, y={yw_c:.4f}, D={D_corner:.4f}')
"", "description": "Triangulate jug and corner from obs_0084"}
